collectables.name: Reins of the Bone-White Kodo
collectables.blurb: An elder's kodo from Thunder Bluff, pale as chalk and older than most towns.

collectables.name: Key to the Steamwheedle Runabout
collectables.blurb: A goblin's brass strider with a leaky boiler and no brakes worth the name.

collectables.name: Tidecaller Sea Turtle
collectables.blurb: A great turtle from the Tempest Isle shallows, slow to look at and quick under you.

collectables.name: Reins of the Dread Elk
collectables.blurb: A black elk with green fire in its antlers, from the edge of the corrupted woods.

collectables.name: Sunreach Hawkstrider
collectables.blurb: A tall gold and white strider bred by the Sunreach Conclave.

collectables.name: Reins of the Ashen Nightmare
collectables.blurb: A black horse with an ember mane, ridden out of the Plaguelands' worst night.

collectables.name: Charm of the Murloc
collectables.blurb: Mrglglgl.

collectables.name: Charm of the Kobold Miner
collectables.blurb: Candle included. You no take it.

collectables.name: Charm of the Gnoll Brute
collectables.blurb: Hunched, hungry and very pleased with itself.

collectables.name: Charm of the Treant Sapling
collectables.blurb: A walking sprig of Ashenvale.

collectables.name: Charm of the Little Ooze
collectables.blurb: It squelches. It's happy.

collectables.name: Charm of the Carrion Crow
collectables.blurb: Hops more than it flies.

collectables.name: Charm of the Furbolg Elder
collectables.blurb: A grey-muzzled furbolg with a walking stick.

collectables.name: Charm of the Wandering Skeleton
collectables.blurb: The Forsaken find it in poor taste.

collectables.name: Charm of the Spirit Wolf
collectables.blurb: A ghostly wolf that leaves no tracks.

collectables.name: Charm of the Drowned Shade
collectables.blurb: A drowned courtier of the old queen, walking in a cold blue light.

collectables.name: Windrider Feather of Kalimdor
collectables.blurb: Every flight path in Kalimdor is open to every character.

collectables.name: Windrider Feather of the Eastern Kingdoms
collectables.blurb: Every flight path in the Eastern Kingdoms is open to every character.

collectables.name: Tome of the Swift Hearth
collectables.blurb: The hearthstone's cooldown is halved, for every character.

collectables.name: Hearthstone of the Second Home
collectables.blurb: A second hearthstone, with its own bind and its own cooldown.

collectables.name: Satchel of the Travelling Bank
collectables.blurb: Opens your bank anywhere. Once per market day.

collectables.name: Peddler's Bell
collectables.blurb: Calls a pack-mule peddler who buys anything you're carrying. Once per market day.

collectables.name: Courier's Horn
collectables.blurb: A courier brings your mail and takes your letters out. Once per market day.

collectables.name: Book of the Wandering Master
collectables.blurb: Opens your class trainer anywhere. Once per market day.

collectables.name: Book of Professions
collectables.blurb: Opens a profession trainer anywhere, for any profession. Once per market day.

collectables.name: Alchemist's Satchel
collectables.blurb: Opens a reagent seller anywhere. Once per market day.

collectables.name: Tome of the Pack Mule
collectables.blurb: Every character's backpack holds 12 more.

collectables.name: Tome of the Deep Vault
collectables.blurb: Every character's bank gets one more tab, free: the Collector's Shelf.

collectables.name: Tome of the Quick Study
collectables.blurb: Apprentice Riding costs nothing at the riding trainer, for every character.

collectables.name: Book of First Steps
collectables.blurb: New characters start with a six-slot bag and 5 gold.
